# heinzel-tailscale

Share the authenticated web app privately through Tailscale Serve: a Heinzelmännchen plugin.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | **capability** |
| Version | `0.7.17` (first-party, released with Heinzelmännchen) |
| Source | <https://github.com/helmut-hoffer-von-ankershoffen/heinzel/tree/main/plugins/heinzel-tailscale> |
| Licence | MIT |
| Install | `hz system plugin add tailscale --confirm` |
| Modules | `tailscale` |

- Capability: adds operations of its own, commands people and agents run.

## Operations

Each column follows the kernel's actual exposure rules. MCP over stdio runs as its caller; HTTP MCP and public REST exclude private operations. Private API and web endpoints require their scoped bearer or paired session. Authentication does not grant human approval. Every CLI command takes `--json`.

| Operation | CLI | MCP stdio | MCP HTTP | REST | Private API | Web | Changes state | Audience |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Show private sharing readiness without changing Tailscale or configuration. | `hz tailscale status` | `tailscale_status` | — | — | `GET /tailscale/status` | `GET /api/tailscale/status` |  | expert |
| Share hz privately over Tailscale, preserving existing services and requiring authenticated readiness. | `hz tailscale enable` | `tailscale_enable` | — | — | `POST /tailscale/enable` | `POST /api/tailscale/enable` | yes | expert |
| Stop only hz's private Serve mapping and remove only the origin permission this plugin added. | `hz tailscale disable` | `tailscale_disable` | — | — | `POST /tailscale/disable` | `POST /api/tailscale/disable` | yes | expert |

## Settings

In your configuration file (`hz system config set <key> <value>`), or as environment variables.

### `[tailscale]`

| Key | Type | Default | Environment variable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `https_port` | integer | `443` | `HZ_TAILSCALE__HTTPS_PORT` | The private Tailscale HTTPS port. Existing services on it are preserved. (user scope only) |
| `intent` | SharingIntent or null | `null` | `HZ_TAILSCALE__INTENT` | The last explicit sharing request and its owned mapping; status reads never execute it. (user scope only) |
